name: Notice
purpose: A short message about what just happened or what to know.
whenToUse: A note that applies to the whole page or form

props.name: urgent
props.does: Uses role alert, which interrupts; otherwise role status, which waits

accessibility.web: role=status by default, role=alert only when urgent. Colour is never the only signal: the words carry the meaning.
accessibility.android: Text with a polite or assertive live region

content: Say what happened in plain words: Message sent. A reply comes within two days.
